caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object that resembles a teal or blue-green fabric pouch or case with a slightly textured appearance. The object is bordered by a twisted rope trim in alternating colors of white and blue, which also forms decorative loops on the front. At the center of the pouch’s front side, there is a cream-colored, irregular oval or cartouche framed by the same blue and white cord, inside which there is a floral arrangement composed of pink, pale yellow, white, and deep pink flowers with green leaves. Near the upper part of the pouch is a small, similarly framed oval with the letter "A" inscribed in a light, elegant script. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Handkerchief Folder
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
